_what: Paths that something else replaced in this repository, as DATA for the control plane's edit-time guard and commit-time gate. Retired code leaves the tree in one commit, after `git tag <tag> <last commit that has it>` (tag is retired/<name>-<retired_at>), so it moves into history and is not lost; a commit that deletes a file of an entry is refused unless its `tag` holds that file. Once a path is retired nothing new may be added to it or built on it: a change is refused when it adds lines to a path matching an entry's `path` (a move inside it or a deletion adds none), or adds a reference (a line matching one of the entry's `reference_patterns`, in a file `reference_judged` names that is not itself retired) to it; the refusal names `replaced_by`, where the work belongs. `path` is a glob: `*` is any characters but `/`, `**` any characters, and a match also covers everything under a matched folder.

retired.replaced_by: The one generic record graph: relations and activities over any records, from the engine's product/record-model.json (read and written through records:read, records:list and records:write), ported into this Workshop as the record-graph tools
